content: Mmbe, imigirʉ ja Musa ni‑kiikiriiri cha amangʼana amazʉmu ganʉ gakuuza, nawe ɨtarɨ amangʼana ageenegeene. Nangʉ ibhimweso bhɨnʉ bhikuhuruchibhwa imyaka jʉsi kʉhɨtɨra imigirʉ giyo, bhɨtakʉtʉra zee kʉbhɨngukya bhanʉ bhakosengera Mungu.

Angabhɨɨrɨ nɨ‑maheene ibhimweso bhiyo bhɨrabhɨngukya, bhanʉ bhakosengera Mungu, bhataarɨ bhariiyigwa mozekoro zaabhʉ nɨ‑bhakʉri bhʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ. Na bhaarɨ bharatiga kuhurucha ibhimweso bhyabhʉ, kʉ kʉbha bhaarɨ bhamarirɨ kʉbhɨngukibhwa.
Nawe ibhimweso bhɨnʉ bhakuhurucha imyaka jʉsi bhɨhaabhahiitya ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwabhʉ,
kʉ kʉbha ɨtakʉtʉrɨkana amasaahɨ ga zihiiri na ga zimburi kuruusha ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwa abhaatʉ.
Necho hanʉ Kiriisitʉ iizirɨ kʉʉsɨ, akabhʉʉrɨra Mungu,

content.text: nʉʉrʉ kɨnʉ kikuhuruchwa igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ.
chɨmburya yandikirwɨ mʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu igʉrʉ waanɨ.’ ”

content: Igʉrʉ hayo Kiriisitʉ akabhuga, “Awɨ ʉtɨɨndirɨ nʉʉrʉ ikimweso chu ukurichwa ni ikimweso igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ, na ʉtazʉmɨrɨɨrwɨ nabhyʉ.” Akagambabhu nangabha ibhimweso bhyʉsi bhiyo bhyarɨ bhɨrahurukibhwa kʉrɨngʼaana ni imigirʉ ja Musa.
Akʉmara akabhuga, “Mungu! Inyɨ nɨrɨ hanʉ, korereke nɨbhɨ nɨrakora ubhwɨndi bhwazʉ.” Mungu akaruushaho ibhimweso bhyɨ ɨkarɨ, na akatʉʉra ikimweso cha Kiriisitʉ.
Nangʉ, kʉ kʉbha Yɨɨsu aarɨ arakora ganʉ Mungu akwenda, itwɨ tʉbhɨngukiibhwɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwɨtʉ kʉnzɨra ya Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, ku kwihurucha rogendo rʉmwɨbhu kʉbha ikimweso.
Na sikʉ zʉʉsi abhakuhaani bhahaasengera na kuhurucha ibhimweso bhiryabhirya manga kaaru, bhɨnʉ bhɨtakʉtʉra kuruushaho ʉbhʉbhɨ nʉʉrʉ hasuuhu.
Kiriisitʉ akiihurucha rogendo rʉmwɨbhu kʉbha ikimweso kemerano, igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwɨtʉ. Akʉmara akiikara ʉrʉbhaara rwu ubhuryʉ rwa Mungu.
Kwɨma hayo ararɨnda kuhika hanʉ Mungu araatʉʉrɨ abhabhisa bhaazɨ iyaasɨ wa amagʉrʉ gaazɨ.
Mmbe, kukwihurucha rogendo rʉmwɨ kʉbha ikimweso, abhakʉrirɨ kʉbha bhanagu abhaatʉ bhanʉ aabhɨngukiryɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwabhʉ kemerano.
Ne Ekoro Ɨndɨndu ɨratomenyeekererya igʉrʉ wa ringʼana rɨnʉ, ɨrabhuga,

content.text: bhʉnʉ nɨraakore na abhaatʉ bhaanɨ kuzisikʉ zɨnʉ zikuuza.

content: Akʉmara ɨrabhuga, “Nɨtakuhiita naatu ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwabhʉ na amahocha gaabhʉ amabhɨ.”
Mmbe, arɨɨbhɨ Mungu amarirɨ kobheerera abhaatʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ, bhʉtareeho ubhwɨndi kwikɨ bhu ukuhurucha ikimweso.
Umweya gwu ukuja mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Mungu
Abhahiiri bhaanɨ, igʉrʉ wa amasaahɨ ga Yɨɨsu tunu umweya gu ukusikɨra Aharɨndu ha Aharɨndu kwa kʉkarara.
Ewe akatwigʉrɨra ɨnzɨra iihya yʉ ʉbhʉhʉru, korereke tʉtʉrɨ kwisuka mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Mungu kʉhɨtɨra ripaziya, riyo nɨ‑mʉbhɨrɨ gwazɨ umwene.
Itwɨ tʉna Kuhaani Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wʉnʉ akwimɨɨrɨrɨra inyumba ya Mungu.
Nangʉ twisukɨ mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Mungu kwa mwʉyʉ mwɨrʉ nu ubhwisirirya bhwa amaheene. Mungu atʉbhɨngukiryɨ zekoro zɨɨtʉ zɨmbɨ kʉnzɨra ya amasaahɨ ga Yɨɨsu na kutwoja ɨmɨbhɨrɨ jɨtʉ na amanzi amɨɨrʉ.
Tugwatɨrɨrɨ bhwaheene ganʉ tukwisirirya na kwisega, kʉ kʉbha wʉnʉ aaragɨɨnʼyɨ, ne‑moheene.
Toreenderwa kwihaana umwʉyʉ, korereke tʉsɨɨganɨ na kwikorera amazʉmu.
Na tʉtatiga kurumana hamwɨmwɨ, ncha amanarʉ ga abhandɨ. Nawe twihaanɨ umwʉyʉ, chɨmbu tʉraarore urusikʉ rwʉ ʉkʉgarʉka kʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ rʉrɨ haguhɨ.
Arɨɨbhɨ tʉrakora ʉbhʉbhɨ kwa bhʉsɨɨgʉ ɨnʉ tʉmarirɨ komenya amaheene ga Mungu, mmbe ɨtareeho ikimweso ɨkɨndɨ kɨnʉ kikuhuruchwa igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ.
Kɨnʉ kɨkʉsaaga, nɨ‑kʉrɨnda ɨtɨnɨrʉ ya Mungu no omorero ʉmʉhaari gʉnʉ gukuricha bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhakumwanga.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ aangirɨ kutuna imigirʉ ja Musa, ataarɨ kororerwa bhɨgʉngi, aarɨ ariitwa, kɨtaarɨ bhʉbhɨhʉ obhomenyeekererya bhwa abhaatʉ bhabhɨrɨ hamwɨ bhatatʉ.
Mwiseege nangʉ! Ɨnyaakʉ ɨrabhabhwɨ kʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akorega Umwana wa Mungu na korora amasaahɨ gʉ ʉbhʉragɨ ganʉ gaamʉbhɨngukiryɨ gatarɨ kegero, na kokora ikisiraani igʉrʉ we Ekoro Ɨndɨndu?
Tʉmɨnyirɨ Mungu newe aabhugirɨ, “Ʉkʉrɨhanʼya isiirɨ ni‑igʉrʉ waanɨ, inyɨ niinyɨ nɨkʉrɨhanʼya.” Na akabhuga, “Ʉmʉkʉrʉ aratɨnɨra abhaatʉ bhaazɨ.”
Ni ingʼana rya kwʉbhahya bhʉkʉngʼu kugwa mʉmabhoko ga Mungu wʉ ʉbhʉhʉru.
Nawe muhiitɨ zisikʉ zirya hanʉ mwatangirɨ kobhona ubhwɨrʉ. Nangabha mʉkabhona ɨnyaakʉ kʉrʉ, nawe mukiigumirirya ɨnyaakʉ yiyo.
Ribhaga ɨrɨndɨ mʉkatukwa na kʉnyaakibhwa habhwɨrʉ. Ribhaga ɨrɨndɨ mwarɨ mʉragwatana nabhʉ bhanʉ bhaarɨ bhakobhona ɨnyaakʉ nchi iyaanyu.
Mʉkabharorera ɨbhɨgʉngi bhanʉ bhaabhʉhirwɨ. Na hanʉ mwaruusiibhwɨ ebhegero bhyanyu, mʉkazomerwa, kʉ kʉbha mʉkamenya mozekoro zaanyu mone ekegero ɨkɨzʉmu bhʉkʉngʼu kɨnʉ kikwikara sikʉ zʉʉsi.
Mʉtatiga ʉbhʉkararu bhuyo, kʉ kʉbha mʉrabhona ʉmʉbhanʉ mʉkʉrʉ bhʉkʉngʼu kurwa kwa Mungu.
Moreenderwa kwigumirirya, korereke mʉtʉrɨ kokora ganʉ Mungu akwenda na mobhone kɨnʉ Mungu aaragɨɨnʼyɨ kʉbhaha.
Chɨmbu Amaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu gakubhuga,

content.text: Nawe ʉmʉʉtʉ we eheene kwa niinyɨ,

content: Mmbe, itwɨ tʉtarɨ gatɨ wa abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhatakwisirirya Mungu na kurimɨra. Nawe tʉrɨ hamwɨmwɨ na bhanʉ bhakumwisirirya na kʉsabhurwa.
